business.name: Cove (NOAM Co.)
business.business_model: Private-beta Mac cloud-drive product from NOAM Consultancy (Yorkshire); waitlist-led acquisition before public download

objective.primary: Grow qualified private-beta waitlist signups for Cove without live ad-account mutation until explicitly approved
objective.conversion_definition: Waitlist join via POST /api/waitlist (email + role + Mac) attributed with UTM and Mixpanel events when configured
success_metrics: Land page to waitlist conversion rate
Cost per waitlist join when paid media is live

assumptions: No live ad accounts are connected yet; account_id values are placeholders
Primary paid channels for founding beta are Meta, Google Search/Demand Gen, and LinkedIn
British English and Cove brand tokens from src/config/site.ts remain source of truth for claims
Live account writes stay disabled until platform, operation, approval, idempotency, verification, audit, and rollback gates pass

retention.purpose: Support Cove paid-media planning and draft-only workflows without storing credentials or account exports in the repo

deletion.method: Operator deletes .claude-ads/runs artifacts and rotates any local exports outside the repo; profiles are rewritten or removed by commit
